judgments.label: physical-error
judgments.evidence: MISSED POLLUTION (auto layer all-pass). Query pins the measurement-noise realization: '(voltage std_dev=0.01, power std_dev=1.0, seed=9496)'. The generated code calls np.random.seed(9496) only AFTER all noise draws are consumed (draws come from unseeded global RNG state) -- the pinned seed is a no-op, so the SE input measurements and the reported scalar are NONDETERMINISTIC. O-EXT-6: three fresh serial runs of the unmodified generated code give 1.0760278969 / 1.0624600271 / 1.0714786878 (rel vs GT +1.48% / +0.20% / +1.05%); with the benchmark's original exec (1.0653635156, +0.47%, matched) and the auto-layer re-exec (1.0726122228, +1.15%, would NOT match), 2 of 5 observed executions land inside the 1% rtol window -- the accepted match was a tolerance-window coin flip (F-E). Reference is deterministic and reproduces GT (1.0603804479 twice). Additional deviations (noise drawn with std 0.01/1.0 directly vs ref 0.003/0.5/0.3; superset line/trafo measurements; v-measurements on all vs in-service buses) change the estimation problem but are secondary: no legal reading of the query yields a nondeterministic answer, so R2 (all pinned dims faithful) and R3 (faithful legal reading) exemptions are unavailable and the equivalence exception fails at (b). Channel: F-D (query-pinned noise/seed violated) realized as F-E coincidental scalar hit; check-5 v2 passed only because unseeded RNG makes the output move under ANY re-run -- instrument blind spot.
